design_fields.q1_rationale: The study does not model plausible values-based achievement as it focuses on dichotomous item scoring.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that it did not use sampling weights in its analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study uses student-level models without accounting for school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study performed only internal validation through cross-validation and train/test splits.
